audit.whatIsWrong: The page is built around an ability called 'Dash Chain' and a second called 'Repel'. Neither exists in Ambessa's kit.
audit.why: Her real abilities are Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep transforming into Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E) and Public Execution (R). The matchup-defining cooldown is Public Execution — a 1250-range blink that suppresses and then stuns, which the Satchel cannot escape once it lands.
audit.corrected: focus.text, tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, phases[3].why and the dos/donts retitled onto Public Execution, Lacerate and Drakehound's Step.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] says she 'has no dashes' at level 1, and late quotes a 62%+ win rate that does not match the data.
audit.why: Drakehound's Step is her passive: entering an attack or move command while casting any ability dashes her a short distance and empowers her next attack — it is available the moment she has one ability, so level 1 is a range advantage (her 650 Q against your 850 Q), not an absence of mobility. Public Execution returns every 130/115/100s, which is the real late-game clock.
audit.corrected: whys[0] restated on the 650-vs-850 range gap; late rebuilt on the 100s R cooldown with no win-rate number quoted.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 3 spike invents a 'Cunning Sweep-Repel gap-close' and a 'W stack'; wants.foe[1] invents 'passive marks'; nothing mentions Public Execution's healing or the auto-reset tell.
audit.why: Cunning Sweep (Q) transforms into Sundering Slam after it strikes; Repudiation (W) is a braced shield that hits harder if it blocked damage — it stacks nothing. Lacerate (E) is the short dash, and starting Drakehound's Step from it makes her strike a second time. Public Execution heals her, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended fights, and her burst opens on an empowered attack wind-up rather than a cast.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, whys[2], wants.foe[0] and wants.foe[1] rebuilt on the real kit; dontsFull[2].d now carries the anti-heal requirement.
